## Checklist

- [ ] I opened every source link myself and each one states this person has died
- [ ] At least two sources are **primary**
- [ ] The sources are **independent** — none is repeating another, and they are not the same outlet twice
- [ ] This is **not** based on account inactivity, a silent profile, or an unanswered message
- [ ] I confirmed this is the right person and not someone with a similar name
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes
- [ ] The summary describes what they built, and does not speculate about their death or private life
- [ ] Any photograph is freely licensed or has recorded permission, and `photo.permission` says which

## Anything the reviewer should know
